name: m2_rolling_v1
validation: previous calendar year; expanding training ends before validation; purge final two exchange dates from train and validation
label: Ref($close,-2)/Ref($close,-1)-1
label_normalization: within-day rank on the identical matched universe, (rank_pct-0.5)*3.46; raw return used for evaluation
feature_processing: exact 158 raw Qlib expressions; infinities become missing; LightGBM native missing handling; no whole-history fitted preprocessing
universe: daily historical nonfinancial CSI300, known contemporaneous industry, tradable, both fixed neutral BP and cashflow available; same rows for every model
candidate_definitions: unchanged BP and CASHFLOW_MARGIN_YTD; legacy full-string industry compatibility only before 2013; prior 2015+ scores must be byte-value identical
illiquidity: excluded from model queue by frozen annual coverage failure; no formula repair
blend_rule: cross-sectional percentile ranks of base prediction and candidate on the same rows; fixed weights; no selection by blend results
selection: Among gate-passing variants choose largest net annual increment; exact ties prefer ADD_BP then ADD_CASHFLOW then ADD_BOTH. None passing means NO_GO and protected periods remain unopened.

qualification.entry: only the single frozen historical GO winner versus identical BASE; same annual expanding-window protocol
qualification.failure: stop candidate, no sign/window/model retuning, lockbox remains unopened

lockbox.entry: qualification winner only; one execution of frozen annual protocol

research_status: 2015-2020 burned historical diagnostics, not fresh OOS; engineering completion does not imply independent alpha
budget: 24 fixed fits, six continuous matched portfolio backtests, no hyperparameter search; qualification/lockbox only through prior gates
